subject: SF exec workshop — corporate card block + airline refund / visa for guest
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@globex.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: SF exec workshop — corporate card block + airline refund / visa for guest

Quick update from the road — two travel issues I need help with before tomorrow's workshop: 

1) My corporate card got flagged and a $1,200 hold was placed by PacificAir when they tried to reissue my ticket after we changed flight times. I called but they only released the hold if the card issuer confirms the charge. Payments team, can someone confirm the auth so we don't have to rebook? Screenshot attached (card_hold_screenshot.png).

2) Oliver is bringing a guest speaker from Germany. Their visa paperwork needs a hotel invoice to support the B1 visa letter. Oliver — can you confirm which nights you need on the invoice? Finance, can we generate an interim invoice/hotel confirmation we can send to consulate? Hotel receipt from the group booking is attached (hotel_receipt_globex.pdf).

Immediate asks: Laura — can you escalate to card ops and advise whether we should submit a manual reimbursement instead if carrier won't release the hold? Rishi — if we need a company letter for visa, can your office sign?

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@globex.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SF exec workshop — corporate card block + airline refund / visa for guest

Thanks for flagging, Jonas. I pulled the authorization logs — card ending in 7345 shows a pending authorization for $1,200 from PACIFIC AIR dated 2026-05-03 07:45 PDT. We're contacting the card provider (Stripe Issuing) now to confirm it's a valid hold and request release.

If the carrier refuses to release, we have two fallback options:
- Option A (preferred): Finance confirms the auth by providing the carrier the merchant reference we have and they drop the hold within 24 hours.
- Option B: If the hold persists and PacificAir requires a different card, we'll reimburse any out-of-pocket charges after you submit an expense report + receipts. Use the attached expense_report_template.xlsx and mark as "urgent - exec workshop".

Visa paperwork: we can provide an interim invoice. Marissa, can you generate the hotel confirmation/invoice with the group booking reference and send it to Oliver by EOD? I'll copy Legal if they need to sign.

Attachments: expense_report_template.xlsx

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@globex.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SF exec workshop — corporate card block + airline refund / visa for guest

Appreciate the quick response. The guest (Dr. Anika Vogel) needs an invoice showing hotel nights May 3-6 and the company name 'Globex Corporation' on the invoice. Hotel confirmation is attached (hotel_receipt_globex.pdf) but it doesn't show guest name on a separate line. If you can add the nights and company name that will work for the consulate.

Regarding the airline: PacificAir reissued the ticket and then flagged the card when I asked them to add Dr. Vogel's frequent flyer number. If the hold delays check-in, Globex will cover any immediate out-of-pocket incidental charges for the guest; we'll request reimbursement from Redwood later. For transparency, please put the reimbursement request in Concur (Concur:EXP-3278).

- Oliver
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Legal Team <legal@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SF exec workshop — corporate card block + airline refund / visa for guest

Sounds good. Jonas — please keep any receipts and a short note of what was charged to the card. If Globex covers incidentals, we'll need a statement from them (email is fine) for our records. Marissa — please prepare a signed hotel invoice with the company name and send the visa support letter template to Oliver. Legal, if a signature is required on the visa letter, please advise the minimal language we should include.

If the card hold forces rebooking that increases cost, we'll evaluate on a case-by-case basis; escalate to me and I'll approve any reasonable delta under $2k. Anything above that I need to run by the CFO.

- Rishi
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@globex.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SF exec workshop — corporate card block + airline refund / visa for guest

Quick summary/follow-ups after calls this morning: 
- Card ops confirmed with Stripe Issuing and PacificAir that the pending auth will be released within 6-12 hours once the carrier reconciles (they put the reissue through as a pending charge). No further action required unless the hold persists past 18:00 PDT.
- Marissa has attached the signed hotel invoice and visa letter (hotel_receipt_globex.pdf). Oliver, can you confirm receipt and forward to Dr. Vogel's consulate?
- If anybody ends up paying for airline incidentals, put the expenses in the attached template and mark Concur EXP-3278; Laura will route as urgent reimbursement.

Thanks all — see you at the 0900 check-in tomorrow.

Jonas
[Thread-level attachments referenced above: boarding_pass_JW_0503.pdf; card_hold_screenshot.png; expense_report_template.xlsx; hotel_receipt_globex.pdf]
